name: CIRCL
on:
  push:

jobs:
  amd64_job:
    name: Go-${{matrix.GOVER}}/amd64

      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Go-${{ matrix.GOVER }}
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GOVER }}
      - name: Linting
        uses: golangci/golangci-lint-action@v9
        with:
          version: v2.12.2
      - name: Check shadowing
        run: |
         # Pin x/tools to a version compatible with the oldest Go version in the CI matrix.
         go install golang.org/x/tools/go/analysis/passes/shadow/cmd/shadow@v0.49.0
         go vet -vettool=$(which shadow) ./... 2>&1 | awk -f .etc/action.awk
        shell: bash
      - name: Verifying Code
        run: |
         go generate -v ./...
         test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
         go vet ./...
        shell: bash
      - name: Building
        run: go build -v ./...
      - name: Testing
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./...

    name: Go-${{matrix.GOVER}}/arm64

        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GOVER }}
      - name: Building
        run: go build -v ./...
      - name: Testing
        run: go test -v -count=1 ./...
  wasm_job:
    needs: [amd64_job]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    name: Testing on WASM
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v6
        with:

      - name: Setting WASM Runtime
        run: echo $(go env GOROOT)/lib/wasm >> $GITHUB_PATH
      - name: Building
        run: GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go build -v ./...
      - name: Testing
        run: GOOS=js GOARCH=wasm go test -v -count=1 ./...

    needs: [amd64_job]

name: Checks

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:

jobs:
  checks:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # submodules: the SoloPlay submodule cannot be checked in isolation (its tsconfig points at
      # ../../sdk and ../../libs), so the parent checkout is where it gets validated - against the
      # exact commit this repo pins.
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          submodules: recursive

      # Node 24: eslint-plugin-es-x@10 requires ^22.23.0 || ^24.18.0 || >=26.4.0, and
      # eslint@10 requires ^20.19.0 || ^22.13.0 || >=24. Anything older cannot run the toolchain.
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: npm

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      # lint:check, never `lint` - that one is `eslint --fix`, which would rewrite files in CI
      # and let anything auto-fixable pass silently.
      - name: ESLint
        run: npm run lint:check

      - name: Typecheck
        run: npm run typecheck

      # The no-undef inventory is generated. If someone adds a global without regenerating,
      # the committed file goes stale and no-undef quietly stops covering it.
      - name: Globals inventory is current
        run: npm run globals:check

      - name: Typecheck (SoloPlay submodule)
        run: npm run typecheck:soloplay

      # Every runtime .js must belong to a TS program. A file in none gets no typechecking and
      # no editor intellisense, and nothing else reports it.
      - name: No orphaned files
        run: node tools/audit/program-files.mjs --check
